corpTax.marginalReliefNote: Demo uses linear interpolation between 19% and 25% for profits £50k–£250k.

RD_SME.summary: SME R&D relief: increased deduction for qualifying R&D expenditure. Demo applies effect via explanation, not precise HMRC formula.

AIA.summary: Annual Investment Allowance: 100% first-year deduction on qualifying plant and machinery up to the threshold. Demo subtracts capex from profit.

PATENT_BOX.summary: Patent Box: 10% effective rate on relevant IP profits. Demo applies 10% to declared patent profits slice.
